review_scope: Claude AI technical review (Opus 5.5); translated directly from the English for item 700's anonymised error reports, spaCR AI (free) and usage bar; no native-speaker or human signoff.

records.key: AI Error report
records.source: AI Error report
records.translation: Informe de errores de IA

records.source: Best-model questions used today · {light} of {total} lighter-model questions left · resets at {time}
records.translation: Preguntas al mejor modelo agotadas hoy · quedan {light} de {total} preguntas al modelo más ligero · se restablece a las {time}

records.key: Daily share used. Errors are still reported without an AI summary.

records.translation: La capacidad gratuita es baja, así que ahora todos reciben el modelo más ligero · quedan {light} preguntas hoy · se restablece a las {time}

records.key: Free every day: {best} questions on the best model, then {light} on a lighter model. Resets at {time}.
records.source: Free every day: {best} questions on the best model, then {light} on a lighter model. Resets at {time}.
records.translation: Gratis cada día: {best} preguntas al mejor modelo y después {light} a un modelo más ligero. Se restablece a las {time}.

records.key: Generated advice from spaCR hosted AI ({model}). It can be wrong; check it before you act on it.
records.source: Generated advice from spaCR hosted AI ({model}). It can be wrong; check it before you act on it.
records.translation: Consejo generado por la IA alojada de spaCR ({model}). Puede ser erróneo; compruébelo antes de actuar en consecuencia.

records.key: No free spaCR AI questions left today · resets at {time}
records.source: No free spaCR AI questions left today · resets at {time}
records.translation: No quedan preguntas gratuitas a spaCR AI hoy · se restablece a las {time}

records.key: Not set up on this computer yet: press Providers… to install it and sign in. Until then spaCR AI (free) answers.
records.source: Not set up on this computer yet: press Providers… to install it and sign in. Until then spaCR AI (free) answers.
records.translation: Aún no está configurado en este equipo: pulse Proveedores… para instalarlo e iniciar sesión. Mientras tanto responde spaCR AI (gratis).

records.key: Which assistant the AI switch routes through. spaCR AI (free) needs no account and answers within a daily allowance; Claude, GPT (Codex) and Gemini use your own CLI login. A switch takes effect at once.
records.source: Which assistant the AI switch routes through. spaCR AI (free) needs no account and answers within a daily allowance; Claude, GPT (Codex) and Gemini use your own CLI login. A switch takes effect at once.
records.translation: Por qué asistente pasa el interruptor de IA. spaCR AI (gratis) no necesita cuenta y responde dentro de una cuota diaria; Claude, GPT (Codex) y Gemini usan su propio inicio de sesión de la CLI. Un cambio surte efecto de inmediato.

records.key: You've used today's free spaCR AI questions. They reset at {time}.
records.source: You've used today's free spaCR AI questions. They reset at {time}.
records.translation: Ha usado las preguntas gratuitas de spaCR AI de hoy. Se restablecen a las {time}.
